plain.li: [fealty,warm,letter] Your letter was read before our head, and every voice in the room was for it. Make ready for us at your gate.
[fealty,warm,call] Yes, and gladly, {WRITER}. Someone of ours will be at your gate to hear the oath.
[fealty,cordial,theirHightech] Your request is approved. Expect someone at your gate to settle the terms in person.
[fealty,cordial,letter,theirLowtech] We will take your oath. Keep your gate open for the one we send, and your word ready.
[fealty,cool,call] All right, we'll take it. Pay on time and we'll have no quarrel, {WRITER}.
[fealty,cool,letter] We accept your oath. See that the tribute is never late, and that your fighters come when called.
[fealty,refusal,letter,theirLowtech] Our head will not take your oath now. We cannot spare the fighters to keep our side of it.
[fealty,refusal,letter,theirHightech] After review, we cannot extend protection to your settlement at this time.
[greetings,warm,fealty:oath,theirLowtech] Those who hold of us are always welcome to write. Our head asks that your colony keeps its walls strong.
[greetings,cordial,fealty:oath,theirHightech] Thanks for the update. Your standing with us remains good.
[greetings,cool,fealty:oath,!fealty:short] We have your letter. Your tribute speaks louder than your words, and so far it has spoken well.
[greetings,cordial,fealty:oath,fealty:levies] Our call on your oath was heard this season, and our head remembers how it was answered.
[greetings,warm,fealty:oath,fealty:protected,theirLowtech] Our band is home from your walls with stories of your people. They say you hold a line like our own.
[news,cordial,fealty:oath] Here is our news. As one who holds of us now, your colony should know how things stand with us.
[news,cool,fealty:oath,fealty:short] Here is our news. We would rather have had your tribute than your questions.
[help,warm,fealty:oath] What we send is for those who hold of us, and gladly given. Use it well.
[help,cordial,fealty:oath,theirLowtech] We do not let those who hold of us go hungry. Take this, and keep your oath.
[help,refusal,fealty:oath] You hold of us for protection, not for a pantry. We cannot spare it.
[help,refusal,fealty:oath,fealty:short] You still owe us tribute, and now you ask for help? Pay what you owe first.
[warning,cordial,fealty:oath] Thank you for the warning. If it reaches your walls, our band will come if it can.
[invitation,warm,fealty:oath] We will come, and gladly. It is good for those who hold of us to see our faces.
[invitation,cool,fealty:oath] We will see your colony when our collector does. That will have to do.
[condolences,warm,fealty:oath] Your dead are mourned here as our own would be. You hold of us, and your grief is ours.
[greetings,warm,vassal:town] Our kin under your protection send their greetings with ours. They speak well of your colony.
[greetings,cordial,vassal:town,theirHightech] Our relatives under your protection report that things are stable. Thank you for that.
[greetings,cool,vassal:town,vassal:heavy,theirLowtech] Our kin under your protection grow thinner each harvest. We hope your colony enjoys the bread.
[news,cordial,vassal:town,vassal:levy] Here is our news. Our kin fought at your walls when you called, and their families are proud of them.
[help,warm,vassal:town] Take this, and think of our kin under your protection when you use it.
[help,refusal,vassal:town,vassal:heavy] You take a heavy share of our kin's harvest, and now ask us for more? No.
[condolences,cordial,vassal:town] Our kin under your protection grieve with you, and so do we.
[fealtyoath,us,tribal] Our clan meets you at the gate with open hands and an honest oath.
[fealtyoath,us,medieval] The colony is ready to swear fealty before you and these witnesses.
[fealtyoath,us,industrial] We've read the terms, and the colony is ready to sign on.
[fealtyoath,us,spacer] The colony accepts the charter's terms, and I'm here to say so in person.
[fealtyoath,us,kind] Thank you for coming all this way to hear us.
[fealtyoath,us,rain] Forgive the weather, we'd have had it fine for you if we could.
[fealtyoath,us,lowmood] Let's get it done, then.
[fealtyterms,them,theirLowtech] Tribute when the season turns, fighters when we call, and our band at your walls.
[fealtyterms,them,theirHightech] Seasonal dues, two of your people on call, and our response team when you're hit.
[fealtyterms,them] You pay each season and come when we call, and we come when you're raided.
[fealtyterms,them,abrasive] Pay on time, come when called, and don't make me regret this.
[fealtyterms,them,kind] We ask what we must and no more, and we keep our word.
[fealtyterms,them,winter] Winter or not, the tribute comes each season, and so do we when you need us.
[fealtysworn,them] It's done, and your gate is under our protection from today.
[fealtysworn,them,theirLowtech] It is sworn before witnesses, and my people will know it by nightfall.
[fealtysworn,them,theirHightech] Terms agreed and witnessed, and you're under our protection now.
[fealtysworn,them,abrasive] Sworn, and I'll hold you to every word of it.
[fealtysworn,them,highmood] Sworn, and a good day for both our peoples.
[fealtysworn,them,rain] Sworn in the rain, which my people say makes an oath hold faster.
